title: Document Loading Module
summary: This module provides foundational interfaces and concrete implementations for loading documents from various sources. It includes an abstract base class for document loaders and a specific loader for fetching examples from LangSmith datasets.

nodes.label: Define Document Loading Interface
nodes.title: Base Document Loader
nodes.description: An abstract base class that defines the standard interface for all document loaders, including methods for loading documents, lazy loading, and splitting documents into chunks.

nodes.label: Load LangSmith Dataset Examples
nodes.title: LangSmith Dataset Loader
nodes.description: Loads examples from LangSmith datasets as Document objects, mapping example inputs to page content and storing full examples in metadata. Supports filtering and content formatting.

nodes.label: Convert Data to String
nodes.title: Data Stringifier Utility
nodes.description: A utility function that converts input data (string or dictionary) into a string representation, primarily used for formatting document content within the LangSmithLoader.

nodes.label: Document Object
nodes.title: LangChain Document
nodes.description: A fundamental data structure in LangChain representing a piece of text content along with associated metadata. Document loaders produce these objects as their primary output.

nodes.label: Text Splitter
nodes.title: Document Text Splitter
nodes.description: An external component responsible for splitting large text documents into smaller, manageable chunks, often used to prepare documents for processing by language models or vector stores.

nodes.label: LangSmith API Client
nodes.title: LangSmith Client
nodes.description: An external client used to interact with the LangSmith platform API, enabling retrieval of dataset examples and other data for the LangSmithLoader.

groups.label: Core Interfaces
groups.title: Core Document Loading Interfaces
groups.description: Defines the foundational abstract classes for document loaders, establishing the contract for how documents are loaded and processed.

groups.label: Concrete Loaders
groups.title: Specific Document Loaders
groups.description: Implementations of the BaseLoader interface for loading documents from various sources, such as LangSmith datasets.

groups.label: Internal Utilities
groups.title: Module-Specific Utilities
groups.description: Helper functions and internal components that support the functionality of the document loaders within this module.
